description: This file provides utility functions for resolving executable file paths, including handling platform-specific extensions, environment variables, and path resolution logic.

methods.name: isDriveLessWindowsRootedPath
methods.description: Checks if a Windows path is rooted without a drive letter, starting with a colon and slash or backslash.

methods.name: resolveExecutablePathCandidate
methods.description: Resolves a candidate executable path considering home directory expansion, path separators, and absolute/relative paths.

methods.name: resolveWindowsExecutableExtensions
methods.description: Returns possible executable extensions for Windows, considering environment variables and whether the executable already has an extension.

methods.name: resolveWindowsExecutableExtSet
methods.description: Creates a set of executable extensions from environment variables for Windows.

methods.name: isExecutableFile
methods.description: Checks if a given file path points to an executable file, considering platform-specific extension rules.

methods.name: resolveExecutableFromPathEnv
methods.description: Searches for an executable in directories specified by the PATH environment variable.

methods.name: resolveExecutablePath
methods.description: Main function to resolve the full path of an executable, considering current working directory and environment variables.
